characters.name: Gutten
characters.prompt: A determined Norwegian farm boy from the 1400-1850 era with a simple linen shirt, woolen trousers held up by suspenders, a rustic vest, and worn leather shoes. He has a youthful face with bright eyes and messy hair, clutching a magical staff or cloth with curiosity.

characters.name: Moren
characters.prompt: An elderly Norwegian woman dressed in modest 1400-1850 clothing with a headscarf, a lined face from years of hard work, and a gentle smile. Her hands show the signs of time, reflecting a life of daily chores on a simple farm.

characters.name: Nordenvinden
characters.prompt: A powerful and swirling presence of wind personified. Tall and wispy figure cloaked in an icy swirl, radiating a regal yet intimidating aura. An ethereal face partially visible amid the gusts, fitting a mystical force from olden Norway.

characters.name: Gjæstgiveren
characters.prompt: A shrewd innkeeper in 1400-1850 Norwegian attire, wearing a simple apron. Middle-aged with a cunning look in his eyes, standing behind a wooden counter in a rustic inn. He exudes a calculating air, always seeking to benefit from travelers and their treasures.

cleanedMainImagePrompt: Depict a rustic Norwegian farmstead from the 1400-1850 era with a traditional stabbur (storehouse). The young boy stands on the wooden steps holding a small container of flour while the swirling North Wind is blowing it away. The background features rugged mountains, a crisp sky, and hints of historical farm life. Use subdued, earthy colors and authentic Norwegian architectural details to emphasize the time period.
modernMainImagePrompt: Illustrate a contemporary Norwegian suburban setting. A teenage boy in a hoodie and jeans steps out of a neat, modern house just as a strong gust of wind snatches away his bag of flour. Show parked cars, paved roads, and nearby houses with modern design. The overall feel should highlight a normal day suddenly disrupted by the unexpected force of nature.
childMainImagePrompt: Show a bright and colorful cartoon scene set on a friendly farm. A cheerful boy in simple, old-fashioned clothes giggles while trying to keep hold of his flour, with a playful wind character swirling around him. Include a red barn, happy farm animals, and a lighthearted atmosphere that is easy for children to enjoy.
simplifiedMainImagePrompt: Tegn en tradisjonell norsk gårdsplass fra 1400-1850-tallet med et stabbur og fjell i bakgrunnen. Gutten står på trappa mens Nordavinden blåser melet hans bort, omgitt av rolige, varme farger og en koselig bondestemning.
englishMainImagePrompt: Create an illustration of a Norwegian farm in the 1400-1850 era. The boy stands on the stabbur steps, watching in dismay as a powerful gust of the North Wind carries away his flour. Include rustic wooden buildings, surrounding mountains, and a clear Scandinavian sky that captures the folktale’s timeless magic.
